title: Hope in the Wilderness
speaker: Pastor Johnson
summary: A reminder that God makes a way even in barren places, calling His people to trust His promise before they see the outcome.

title: When Grace Meets Doubt
speaker: Elder Matthews
summary: Jesus meets honest questions with mercy, inviting us to bring our uncertainty into His presence rather than hiding it.

title: Blessed Are the Peacemakers
speaker: Youth Pastor Davis
summary: Christ forms a people who bring peace into homes, neighborhoods, and strained relationships through humility and courage.

title: The Shepherd Who Stays
speaker: Pastor Johnson
summary: Even in dark valleys, the Lord remains near, guiding, restoring, and preparing a table of grace for His people.

title: Serving One Another in Love
speaker: Sister Williams
summary: The freedom we have in Christ is expressed not in self-interest, but in joyful service that reflects His love to others.
